limitations.note: The square-wave counter still wraps at 20 instead of 19, leaving a 21-clock period rather than the expected 20-clock period.

The rewrite forces the square output low on mode entry instead of holding the previous output until a counter event, and replaces the triangle’s registered direction logic with endpoint checks that change its post-reset and mode-entry sequence.
The test treats the faulty 21-clock square period as correct and likewise checks the rewritten triangle startup and mode transitions against the agent’s assumptions.
